name: DiskWise
description: 看清 Mac 的空间去向，让磁盘清理有据可依。
descriptionEn: Understand what takes up space on your Mac, before deciding what to clean.

name: Agent Ping
description: 谁在运行，谁在等你。把 AI 会话的动静，放到屏幕一侧。
descriptionEn: See which AI agents are working and which need you, right at the edge of your screen.

name: MakeMovie
description: 从文字、剧本到分镜与成片的开源 AI 影视制作工具。
descriptionEn: A self-hosted AI filmmaking tool, from writing and storyboards to a finished video.

name: 翻译助手
description: 在输入框中翻译并回填，也能对照阅读网页。
descriptionEn: Translate and replace text in input fields, or read web pages side by side in two languages.

name: DailyBox
description: 日常会用到的小工具，放在一个随手就能打开的盒子里。
descriptionEn: A handy collection of everyday tools, all in one place.

name: 星火
description: 让真实的就医经验，被下一个需要的人看见。
descriptionEn: A place to share personal healthcare experiences with others who need them.

name: 四大名著
description: 用人物、关系与回目索引，带人走进中国古典文学。
descriptionEn: Explore Chinese classics through characters, relationships, and chapter guides.

name: Bamboo Scroll
description: 用英文讲述中国历史，让更多人读到其中的人物与故事。
descriptionEn: Bringing Chinese history to English-speaking readers through its people and stories.

name: 燎原
descriptionEn: A reading project for the Selected Works of Mao Tse-tung.

name: 明码 OpenFare
descriptionEn: A tool for comparing flight fares.

name: 上海浮生记
description: 以沪漂生活为题的模拟游戏。
descriptionEn: A simulation game about making a life in Shanghai.
